_comment: These rows are ALL boundary-valid (expect 202) AND their player resolves correctly (run players/valid.json first: qa.player1..10@example.com; player_id is a fake placeholder, resolution happens via player_email). But their payload is missing/invalid for the typed_records mapping in config/gamindo.php, so the correlated answers/transactions/rewards row is skipped gracefully (logged as import.events.typed_skipped) without failing the batch or the event itself. See _reason for what each row is missing.

events._reason: answer_submitted with question_id but neither answer_option_id nor answer_text (require_any)
transaction with a type outside one_of (purchase/spend/refund)
